purpose: Separate target-coverage failure from crop/resampling effects by comparing layer-5 geometric-oracle token selection, layer-5 L2 selection, and ROI-384 at the same per-sample final visual-token budget.
evidence_level: revealed development mechanism diagnostic; not deployable and not blind validation

new_action.selection_rule: Rank target-intersecting merged cells first by overlap, then preserve spatial anchors and nearest context.
new_action.per_sample_final_token_target: ROI-384 final_context_visual_tokens, capped at dense identity

decision_logic: If geometric oracle substantially closes the L2-to-ROI quality gap, target-aware contiguous token selection is supported for the next action-space design.
If geometric oracle remains close to L2 and far below ROI, crop resampling, local magnification, or representation-distribution effects dominate this implementation.
Either result remains an oracle diagnostic and cannot be presented as a deployable selector.
